contexts.text: Their faces become like a round cake.
Make ready quickly three measures of meal of fine flour, knead it, and make cakes () = the Celestial of His love in that state.

The meal of fine flour = the Spiritual and the Celestial then with the Lord, and cakes, the same when both are conjoined.... The meat-offering consisted of fine flour mixed with oil and made into cakes. Explained, Illustrated.
Fine flour made into cakes in general had the same representation as bread, namely, what is celestial of love.
The bread called the bread of faces was made of fine flour, which was prepared in cakes and set upon the table... Explained, Illustrated.
That the Lord's Rational was instructed in what is celestial, and thence in what is spiritual, is signified by the meal of fine flour made into a cake.
A cake of millet (a sign of the Chinese).
Fine flour, and thence cakes, = the Celestial of love, and thence the spiritual of faith, which is charity. References.
The cake which she made for Elijah in the first place () = the good of love to the Lord.

They baked the dough, which they brought forth from Egypt, unleavened cakes () = that from the truth of good there was again produced good in which there was nothing of falsity... The reason cakes = goods, is that they are bread. (Under Bread, see this reference.)
The taste of it was like that of a cake in honey () = good which was delightful, like that which has been made good from truth through delight... Cake = spiritual good.
Meal () = truth from good; oil, good of love; and a cake of them, truth conjoined with its own good.
Cakes of unleavened mixed with oil () = the purification of the middle Celestial. Cakes = the middle Celestial.
The reason cakes = the middle Celestial in the internal man, is that they are in the second order ().
Cakes, in the Word, = the good of love in general: hence it is that the breads of faces are called cakes. Illustrated.
To make cakes to the queen of the heavens () = to worship the devil from the good of celestial love.

But the good of spiritual love is signified by cakes in Hosea; Ephraim has become a cake not turned (); but here cake is expressed by another word in the Original Language, which = the good of spiritual love; a cake not turned exists when the external man reigns over the internal...

A cake of barley with man's dung () = the interior good of the Church defiled with the evils of self-love. A cake with the excrements of an ox () = the external good of the Church defiled with the evils of that love.
Cake = the good of celestial love.
To make cakes to the queen of the heavens = to worship infernal evils of every kind; to make cakes = to worship from evils.
